description: Source code for a Direct3D 11 HEVC (H.265) video decoder accelerator implementation for Windows, handling picture creation, frame submission, slice processing, and error handling within the Chromium media component.

classes.name: D3D11H265Picture
classes.description: Represents an HEVC picture buffer for D3D11 decoding, manages picture usage state.

classes.name: D3D11H265Accelerator
classes.description: Main class implementing HEVC decoding acceleration using D3D11, handling frame submission, slice processing, and error reporting.

methods.name: CreateH265Picture
methods.description: Creates a new HEVC picture object wrapping a D3D11 picture buffer.

methods.name: IsChromaSamplingSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given chroma sampling format is supported.

methods.name: SubmitFrameMetadata
methods.description: Submits frame-level metadata for decoding, including reference picture list setup.

methods.name: RetrieveBitstreamBuffer
methods.description: Obtains a buffer for bitstream data from the decoder context.

methods.name: FillPicParamsWithConstants
methods.description: Fills picture parameters with default constant values.

methods.name: PicParamsFromSPS
methods.description: Populates picture parameters based on SPS data.

methods.name: PicParamsFromPPS
methods.description: Populates picture parameters based on PPS data.

methods.name: PicParamsFromSliceHeader
methods.description: Populates picture parameters based on slice header data.

methods.name: SubmitSlice
methods.description: Prepares and submits a slice for decoding, including bitstream handling and parameter setup.

methods.name: SubmitSliceData
methods.description: Submits accumulated slice data buffers to the decoder.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state and buffers.

methods.name: OutputPicture
methods.description: Outputs a decoded picture to the client.

methods.name: RecordFailure
methods.description: Logs and reports a decoding failure with reason and error code.

methods.name: SetVideoDecoder
methods.description: Sets the current video decoder instance.
